source.note: Captured from reviewed HEAD plus the documented frozen working tree. These images are actual gameplay, not the supplied design board or model export.

method: Each of the 48 final Holding Pier PNGs was opened with view_image detail original and inspected individually. No browser was launched and no image was edited for this inspection. PNG dimensions and SHA-256 below identify exactly the inspected files.
environment: Windows, Chromium/SwiftShader/DPR1 and emulated phone touch as recorded by the capture manifest; this is native image-size inspection, not physical Android approval.
visualDecision: Retain the supplied three transparent PNG derivatives at44 CSSpx. Complete upright rabbit ears, cream/tan coats and the sheep dark face/wool remain recognizable beside the live names and capacity text. The offline model-derived shading is clean at native size and is not pixel-identical WebGL.
observations: Pip is cream and Rue tan in actual boarding and Harbor choices; the 44px portraits remain visible in selected and unselected rabbit states. Sheep Moss has a distinct dark face within the wool silhouette. Eyes/nose are intentionally small model details; silhouette and coat remain the main recognition cues.

Checks occupy a separate copy column and do not cover faces or ears. Full names and1space/2spaces text remain visible at every size. All portrait slots stay beside the copy, without a tall portrait row.

844x390 and390x844 keep compact two-column choices in the actual Harbor preview. At360x740, the title wraps normally and the lower projected tide line needs body scrolling. At780x320 and1440x900, the initial Harbor body also requires a small ordinary vertical scroll to expose the complete lower projection.

320x740 adapts to one column. All three full choice rows fit in the initial Harbor body; consequences and projected result require ordinary vertical scrolling. The dedicated consequence image exposes full future wording and projected load/tide while Close and Confirm remain visible.

The short-phone losing-subset initial image clips the lower warning because the body scrolls, while the dedicated warning-scrolled image shows the complete real loss consequence and projected tide with fixed Close/Confirm. This is deliberate reachable vertical content, not a claim that all content fits simultaneously.

The accepted painted material remains opaque and quiet behind choice text. Portrait alpha edges are clean on both rabbit selection faces, with no baked disk, labels or check. No world silhouette appears through reading panels.

Ordinary play and arrival images retain the accepted cove/boat/animals/lighthouse direction. Existing modal coverage of scene/dock and desktop lower-left secondary-hint/view-control overlap are still visible and are not reported as newly fixed.
limitations: Static images cannot establish timing, native touch, image decoding/failure lifecycle, focus or Undo behavior; those belong to separately executed browser checks.
No physical Android, other-engine, native-GPU performance, alternate platform-font or new acoustic approval.
These capture sets show selected sheep and both selected/unselected rabbits; gallery and separate browser lifecycle evidence cover additional image/failure/selection states.
No blanket human acceptance of the new portraits is claimed. Existing card/dock overlap, delivered-heading observation and180ms rapid-touch verification limit remain separately documented.
